meta.title: Implement pre-computed etag support for mbtiles sources
meta.body_summary: Implement pre-computed etag support in mbtiles sources to eliminate unnecessary xxhash CPU overhead by reusing stored hashes; adds trait method and pipeline integration with full backward compatibility.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added pre-computed etag support; maintainers closed PR saying it's simpler to redo by a human, indicating insufficient Rust code quality.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 340 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. As a moderate performance enhancement PR it was closed—not merged—because maintainers rejected the code quality, preferring a human rewrite.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainers CommanderStorm and nyurik agreed that the PR's Rust code was not great and it would be simpler for a human to redo the implementation.
review_details.performance_claim: Pre-computed etag support eliminates unnecessary CPU usage from xxhash computation, providing instant etag lookup for supported mbtiles types.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainers explicitly stated the PR should be done by a human; closed by CommanderStorm with comment 'simpler if re-done by a human'.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot's Rust code quality was not suitable; maintainers believed a human rewrite would be simpler, indicating a gap in producing idiomatic, maintainable Rust code for this performance optimization task.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers evaluated the PR's approach and code quality, concluding it was insufficient for merge.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler evidence; performance claim is narrative only. Maintainers did not request or discuss performance evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no further fixes attempted.

core_change_summary.description: Added `get_tile_etag()` method to `Source` trait with default returning `None`; implemented in `MbtSource` to extract pre-computed hash from `tiles_with_hash` or `images` tables; integrated into tile serving pipeline with fallback to xxhash; added tests in `martin/src/srv/tiles.rs`.
change_trajectory: Implementation commit: added trait method, mbtiles detection and etag extraction, pipeline integration.
Test commit: added tests for pre-computed etag handling.
